verdict.rationale: Floot's own programmatic surface is a documented remote MCP server, backed by a discovery manifest, OAuth2 and published tools such as get_logs, query_database, execute_sql and create_checkpoint. An AI client can drive the product through it, but it is not a general documented public API. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the manifest confirms there is no REST API, interactive reference, sandbox or versioning surface. Missing for 10: documented REST/HTTP API, OpenAPI spec, API versioning/changelog, sandbox environment, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Floot's only programmatic surface is its remote MCP server
Add Floot to Cursor, VS Code, Zed, or any client that supports remote MCP servers
query_database for reads, execute_sql for writes and migrations, pull_database_schema to regenerate typed helpers.
create_checkpoint labels a point you can revert to from the Checkpoint panel in your project view.
